formRaceEntries.comment: Same sire as Royal Sway out of city winning dam of 4 winners incl city winner Bris Vegas. 2nd/4th Wodonga/Wang jumpouts.
Resumes. Form was fair early in his maiden campaign Had more time & 1st & 2nd in recent jumpouts.
By sire of Golden Mile & first to race out of a two-time sprint winner. 5th & 3rd in Bendigo jumpouts.
Scratched.
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Blinkers ON, Hanoverian Nose Band OFF

formRaceEntries.comment: Same sire as Patriotic Rose, dam raced just once. Fourth and first in latest Bendigo jumpouts.
Didn't finish it off on debut but led & tried hard last time. Could also be in this for a long way.
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) ON, Lugging Bit ON

formRaceEntries.comment: Won a jumpout before a steady effort in a leader's race first-up. Fitter & blinkers on for this.
By sire of Straight Charge & dam has won winner from two to race. Won Wangaratta & Wodonga jumpouts.
Found the line well at first outing since late Jan and will be fitter for it. Worth thought despite the gate.
Same sire as Seeking Stardom, half to stakes placed Astero & fellow city winner Mouse Almighty. Last, Wodonga jumpout.
Same sire as Point Barrow, half to city winner Jumbo Ozaki. Plenty of jumpouts, winning latest at Kyneton.
Same sire as Cool Archie out of a stakes placed import.Last of 8 in latest Caulfield Heath trial.
Covered groound & worked home fairly here fresh. Fitter for that & could improve into a placing.
Much better effort when saviing ground at Wodonga. Tricky gate here but could continue to improve.
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Lugging Bit ON, Nose Roll ON

formRaceEntries.comment: Won a Caul Heath trial before a steady debut outing. Better for it but the draw is no help to him here.
2nd & 4th in trials before working home fairly on debut. Better for it & blinkers go on for this.
formRaceEntries.gearChanges: Blinkers FIRST TIME, Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Blinkers FIRST TIME, Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME

formRaceEntries.comment: Never likely over 1000m on debut. Up in trip for this but needs to find a few lengths.
Raced wide & held his ground at Sale on debur. Better for that & could improve into a placing.
Scratched.
Same sire as Portland Sky out of a dual stakes winning dam of city winners. Won latest Cranbourne jumpout.
